title: Lei n.º 07/2026, Primeira Alteração à Lei n.º 10/1999 (Lei de Base do Ambiente), with the republished text
citation: Lei n.º 07/2026, de 13 de agosto, Diário da República I Série n.º 73 (São Tomé e Príncipe)
evidence: Gazette I Série n.º 73, 13 de Agosto de 2026 (copy read in FAOLEX, http://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/sao72014.pdf, HTTP 200, 311406 bytes, application/pdf, opened 2026-11-09). Entrada em vigor: "A presente Lei entra em vigor nos termos legais." No date is stated. Portugal Global (https://portugalglobal.pt/noticias/2026/setembro/sao-tome-e-principe-atualiza-lei-de-base-do-ambiente/, opened 2026-11-09) says it entered into force on 18 August 2026; not confirmed against an official source.
notes: Environmental framework act: amends Lei n.º 10/1999 of 31 December (Lei de Base do Ambiente) and prints its republished text. The copy was read through FAOLEX, not the official host, which did not answer on 2026-11-09 (code 000). Record not stored: ST-DIARIO-DA-REPUBLICA-ADOPTED is permission requested, so the text may not be stored. Languages: Portuguese is the only official language and the only language of the gazette; no government English text was looked for on the official host because it did not answer. Status link only; in-force date to confirm from the official gazette.
status_note: The official gazette host did not answer; the in-force date rests on a single secondary source.
